A '''virus''' was developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vischera]] inside the [[Vanishing Place]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. A number of [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucian]] children contracted it, resulting in extreme loss of muscle mass and their skin turning sickly gray. However, the children were cured by a group of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] agents sent to the planet to raid the Vanishing Place.
